```python
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import jwt
from argon2 import PasswordHasher
from argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError

from app.config import get_settings

_hasher = PasswordHasher()


def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    return _hasher.hash(password)


def verify_password(password: str, hashed: str) -> bool:
    try:
        return _hasher.verify(hashed, password)
    except VerifyMismatchError:
        return False


def create_access_token(
    subject: str, role: str, tenant_id: str, expires_delta: timedelta | None = None
) -> str:
    settings = get_settings()
    delta = expires_delta or timedelta(minutes=settings.jwt_access_ttl_minutes)
    payload = {
        "sub": subject,
        "role": role,
        "tenant_id": tenant_id,
        "type": "access",
        "exp": datetime.now(timezone.utc) + delta,
    }
    return jwt.encode(payload, settings.jwt_secret, algorithm="HS256")


def create_refresh_token(subject: str, expires_delta: timedelta | None = None) -> str:
    settings = get_settings()
    delta = expires_delta or timedelta(days=settings.jwt_refresh_ttl_days)
    payload = {
        "sub": subject,
        "type": "refresh",
        "exp": datetime.now(timezone.utc) + delta,
    }
    return jwt.encode(payload, settings.jwt_secret, algorithm="HS256")


def decode_token(token: str) -> dict:
    settings = get_settings()
    return jwt.decode(token, settings.jwt_secret, algorithms=["HS256"])
```

import jwt

    decode_token,

    verify_password,

def test_verify_password_rejects_wrong_password():

def test_access_token_roundtrip_carries_role_and_tenant():
    token = create_access_token(subject="user-123", role="rep", tenant_id="tenant-abc")
    payload = decode_token(token)
    assert payload["sub"] == "user-123"
    assert payload["role"] == "rep"
    assert payload["tenant_id"] == "tenant-abc"
    assert payload["type"] == "access"


def test_refresh_token_has_refresh_type_and_no_role():
    token = create_refresh_token(subject="user-123")
    payload = decode_token(token)
    assert payload["sub"] == "user-123"
    assert payload["type"] == "refresh"
    assert "role" not in payload


def test_decode_rejects_expired_token(monkeypatch):
    import app.core.security as security_module

    token = create_access_token(
        subject="user-123", role="rep", tenant_id="tenant-abc", expires_delta=timedelta(seconds=-1)
    )
    with pytest.raises(jwt.ExpiredSignatureError):
        decode_token(token)

        Settings(jwt_secret="short")
    assert "jwt_secret" in str(exc_info.value).lower()

def test_jwt_secret_default_is_long_enough():
    """Default JWT secret passes validation (32+ bytes)."""
    settings = Settings()

   ```python
   jwt_secret: str = "dev-secret-change-me-please-this-needs-to-be-at-least-32-bytes-long"
   ```

   ```python
   @field_validator("jwt_secret", mode="after")
   @classmethod
   def validate_jwt_secret_length(cls, value: str) -> str:
       if len(value.encode("utf-8")) < 32:
           raise ValueError("JWT secret must be at least 32 bytes long")
       return value
   ```

- Runs on all input paths (env var, `.env`, default, programmatic override)
